name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you prove your faith and bond with the Light by wielding the Symbol of Life to restore a fallen ally.
Defias spellcasters in northeastern Elwynn threaten Stormwind's heartland. Gathering intelligence at Heroes' Vigil matters to the Alliance.

faq.answer: Henze Faulk is a defender who went with Gazin to Heroes' Vigil on Stone Cairn Lake to find proof of Defias infiltration. He held off the mages so Gazin could escape, and fell to their spells. The Symbol of Life later restored him to life.
Heroes' Vigil is an island in the middle of Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn Forest. Defias mages and rogues have made an outpost there, where they pore over plans.
The Symbol of Life is a holy item that channels a paladin's faith to restore the fallen. It needs true spiritual conviction, making its use on Henze Faulk a test of a paladin's calling.
faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life?

faq.answer: Gazin Tenorm asks for help after escaping the Defias on the island. Wounded, he lies near the altar in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He is a friend of Duthorian Rall, the paladin leader who sent the initiate to him.
faq.q: Who directs the rescue of Henze Faulk?

aliases: what are defias doing stone cairn lake
faq.answer: Defias operatives have crossed into northeastern Elwynn and gathered at Heroes' Vigil to study documents and coordinate their operations. Henze and Gazin sought those documents as proof for the king's advisors.
faq.q: What are the Defias doing at Heroes' Vigil?

aliases: why were henze and gazin there
faq.answer: Henze Faulk and Gazin went to Stone Cairn Lake after hearing reports of Defias infiltrators. They meant to ambush the conspirators and recover written proof of their plans for King Anduin's advisors in Stormwind.
faq.q: Why did Henze and Gazin go to Stone Cairn Lake?

sections.body:
Henze Faulk and Gazin traveled to Heroes' Vigil after hearing that Defias Brotherhood agents had crossed into northeastern Elwynn Forest. The island lies in the middle of Stone Cairn Lake. The scouts sought proof to present to the king's royal advisors, so they tried to ambush two conspirators reviewing plans.

Defias spellcasters soon joined the fight, and the scouts were overwhelmed. Henze stood his ground against the mages, sacrificing himself to give Gazin time to escape with his life.
sections.title: Ambush at Heroes' Vigil

sections.body:
Ordinary medicine cannot restore Henze; only the Holy Light can. With the Symbol of Life, you are sent to find his fallen body on the island in Stone Cairn Lake.

Your faith, channeled through the sacred artifact, brings Henze back to life. This test shows a paladin's spiritual bond and readiness to serve the Light in Stormwind's defense.
sections.title: The Gift of Resurrection

summary: In Elwynn, faith and sacrifice are tested when a Defias ambush leaves Henze Faulk dead at Heroes' Vigil. With the Symbol of Life, you are sent to restore him and hinder the brotherhood's schemes.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
